1. Open Pages or Numbers on the iPhone at least once so its on-device folder exists in On My iPhone.
How to Transfer Files from iPhone Files App to Mac via USB
2. In the Files App, create a staging folder such as To Mac (USB) inside that app's folder.
How to Transfer Files from iPhone Files App to Mac via USB
3. When scanning a document, save it directly into that staging folder instead of a random location in On My iPhone.
How to Transfer Files from iPhone Files App to Mac via USB
4. Connect the iPhone to the Mac with a data-capable USB cable.
How to Transfer Files from iPhone Files App to Mac via USB
5. Unlock the iPhone. If prompted on the Mac, allow the accessory connection. If prompted on the iPhone, tap Trust This Computer.
How to Transfer Files from iPhone Files App to Mac via USB
6. In Finder, select the iPhone under Locations, click Files, expand the app you used as the staging location, then drag the PDF to a folder on the Mac.
